turns.doctor_question: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you here today?
turns.patient_response: I came in because I just can’t stop noticing this sagging, uneven area around my jaw and neck. I know people tell me it looks normal, but it doesn’t feel normal to me. When families come in, or nurses, or people at church look at me, I feel like that’s the first thing they see.

turns.patient_response: Yes. Before I leave for work or for a meeting, I keep going back to the bathroom mirror and checking it. I’ll fix my collar, move my hair around my neck, then look again in my phone camera. Sometimes I ask my daughter if it looks strange. It’s gotten me late more than once.
